text:
jess: Quick sec ping — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4827 to slim the auth-proxy secret surface for on-prem. Need quick security + privacy review before merge (targeting Friday release). TL;DR: remove global SHARED_KEY, use per-tenant KMS-wrapped tokens and a token-projection sidecar. Touches charts + deploy manifests. @sam @lina can you take a look? ops-bot will post CI status.

ops-bot: CI status: unit tests ✅, lint ✅, integration-tests ❌ (failing in k8s e2e on auth-proxy startup timeout). Logs attached in CI.

sam: Skimmed — looks small and reasonable. Two quick questions: 1) migration plan for existing tokens? 2) any chance plaintext tokens end up in logs/env? Also please add a TokenService unit test.

jess: Migration planned: added scripts/migrate_tokens.sh in the PR that wraps existing tokens with KMS and writes projected secrets. Logs: added redaction in auth/proxy/logging.go (mask token IDs). I'll add the TokenService unit test in the next commit.

lina: Privacy note: we need a short writeup in the PR about retention + who can run the migration job. Also confirm k8s SA scope is reduced as you mentioned so older clusters don't break.

privacy: Reviewed retention/access — retention unchanged. Access is limited to ops role. One ask: include a short paragraph in the PR description listing which users/groups can run the migration (ops only) and link to runbook.

mike: Small nit: in deployment.yaml you had `env: - name: PROXY_SECRET_PATH` — can we use a k8s secret projection (volume) instead? Env vars end up in pod spec and are easier to leak in some environments.

jess: Good catch — switched to secret projection in latest commit and removed SHARED_KEY from charts. Also updated the PR description with runbook link and migration owner. Example migration snippet added to the PR description:

```bash
# one-off migration (ops only)
kubectl -n redwood run migrate-tokens --image=repo/migrate:latest -- 
  /app/migrate_tokens.sh --kube-context=onprem-prod --confirm
```

sam: LGTM from me once integration-tests are green and privacy note is in. :thumbsup: I'll re-run e2e locally tomorrow morning.

jess: Thanks — if we get one more sec ack I'll merge during Friday 10:30am deploy window (canary 10% for 1 hour then full). Rollback plan on failure: revert to previous image and restore chart.

ops-bot: Scheduled deploy window reminder: 2026-03-20 10:30 UTC.

mike: Added one more small suggestion in the PR comment about log levels when migration is running (avoid verbose token dumps).

jess: Noted — will patch. Appreciate the reviews, team.

(reacts: :eyes: from sam, :rocket: from jess)
